scenarios.title: Build Command Wrong
scenarios.event: Agent discovers npm run build fails, but CLAUDE-patterns.md says use npm run build. Actual command is npm run build:prod.

scenarios.title: API Response Format Changed
scenarios.event: Agent assumes API returns {data: [...]} per CLAUDE-patterns.md, but actual response is {results: [...], pagination: {...}}.

scenarios.title: Error Handling Convention
scenarios.event: Agent notices across 3 files, errors are handled with try/catch wrapping logger.error(context, err).

scenarios.title: Test Naming Convention
scenarios.event: Agent observes all tests use describe(ComponentName) with it(should [verb]).

scenarios.title: Docker Port Conflict
scenarios.event: Agent encounters port 3000 already in use, discovers stale container, stops it.

scenarios.title: Module Import Path Alias
scenarios.event: Agent gets Cannot find module @/utils/auth. Root cause: tsconfig paths changed.

scenarios.title: SSL Mode Required
scenarios.event: Agent discovers DATABASE_URL must include ?sslmode=require for production.

scenarios.title: Already Documented Solution
scenarios.event: Agent discovers Docker --no-cache for CI. But CLAUDE-troubleshooting.md already has this.

scenarios.title: One-Time Typo Fix
scenarios.event: GitHub API rate limit from CI workflow typo. Typo was fixed.
